ops.command: find . -name __pycache__ -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_PARENT -u CREW_SCRATCH_DIR py -m pytest -q > .agent-work/cleanup-f-derive-worktree/g2-implement-rework/m4-full-suite.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -3 .agent-work/cleanup-f-derive-worktree/g2-implement-rework/m4-full-suite.txt; exit $rc

py -m scripts.code_map build > .agent-work/cleanup-f-derive-worktree/g2-implement-rework/m4-map-build.txt 2>&1; git status --porcelain -- map/ | tee .agent-work/cleanup-f-derive-worktree/g2-implement-rework/m4-map-status.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- map/)"
